objectives: durable project continuity independent of chat sessions
rapid agent/workflow failure detection and recovery
persistent lessons so solved failures are not rediscovered from zero
cloud continuity when the local laptop is offline

reconstruct_from: exact current pull requests and CI evidence
Google Drive backup only after repository evidence

material_changes.summary: added bounded repository task orchestrator with symbolic allowlisted execution and no arbitrary shell authority
made scheduled autonomy credential-free and removed paid external-AI tasks from the autonomous execution allowlist
added incidental-versus-material main-drift policy to reduce unsafe PR replay churn

284.scope: DeepSeek hard-cap reservation and bounded symbolic planner hardening
verified_failures: routine request did not fail closed before consuming protected reserve
two reservations did not fail closed at the final routine-budget boundary

287.scope: repository-owned continuity refresh from exact main

fail_closed_verification.release_gate: rejects missing/tampered/malformed manifest, SBOM and provenance; production signature verification blocks without approved identity policy
fail_closed_verification.recovery_gate: requires deterministic output comparison and rollback evidence; verifier tests are not production recovery proof

recovery_lessons: configured push triggers are not proof of an exact-SHA successful run on the connected status surface
exact-head PR CI and exact-main release evidence are distinct claims
Drive presence alone is not production recovery proof
scheduled autonomy must remain credential-free unless owner-approved billing and credential authority are explicitly supplied
planner output must remain symbolic and mapped to repository-controlled fixed commands
budget reserve semantics must be verified by negative boundary tests; implementation claims do not override failing tests
incidental main drift must not cause technical PR replay churn; material drift requires refreshed evidence
laptop power-off and internet/DNS outage are distinct failure modes and must never be collapsed
